name: Onna Kenja Elena ~Yokoshima Naru Majutsusha no Soukutsu Hen~
original_name: 女賢者エレナ ～邪なる魔術者の巣窟編～
source:
Elena is an adventurer just finished initial training, but her abilities surpass normal adventurers greatly. She does not need a party of weaklings, so she gets on a journey alone without real experience. Direct monsters attacks are no problem for her, but cunning lures her in a trap...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
埃琳娜是一名刚完成初步训练的冒险者，但能力远远超过普通冒险者。她不需要和一群弱者组队，于是在毫无实战经验的情况下独自踏上旅途。怪物的正面攻击难不倒她，可狡猾的阴谋却将她诱入了陷阱……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
